subject: Nebula CPPO: tech QA, SKU mapping & proposed billing split
messages:
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@nebularesell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>, Kate Oliver <kate.oliver@nebularesell.com>
Date: 2028-06-28T16:12:00Z
Subject: CPPO: technical QA + billing split for Nebula pilot

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Nebula's channel team is aligned and we'd like to move the CPPO pilot into a short sprint so AWS can co-sell. Before we share this with our finance/legal teams we need a few clarifications so we can map internal SKUs and confirm billing flow: 

- SKU mapping: can you confirm which Marketplace SKUs map to the quantized LLM variant (gptx-8q) vs the full-precision fallback? Nebula wants separate line items if possible.
- Entitlement flow: when a customer redeems a private-offer, does Redwood provide an entitlement callback to the reseller to provision access, or is the reseller expected to call your entitlement API?
- Billing split options: Nebula prefers a 60/40 split (reseller share first). What flexibility do you have on that structure and how does invoicing flow?
- Compliance evidence: AWS asked for SOC2 cert + a short note on data residency for any EU-origin customers in the pilot.

Attached: initial reseller onboarding checklist (we'll send that to our legal/finance).

Goal: get a one-page term + a proposed billing CSV we can pass to our accounting team by Tuesday EOD.

Thanks —
Marcus Hale
Head of Channel, Nebula Resell Co.

Attachments: reseller_onboard_checklist.docx (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@nebularesell.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>, Kate Oliver <kate.oliver@nebularesell.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: CPPO: technical QA + billing split for Nebula pilot

Hi Marcus —

Appreciate the clear ask list. Quick answers up front and then I'll loop in ops/legal for the term sheet and billing CSV.

- SKU mapping: we can expose two SKUs in the CPPO listing: redwood.gptx-8q (quantized) and redwood.gptx-8fp (full-precision fallback). We recommend routing default traffic to 8q and using the fallback on the model-policy in Canary mode; I'll include the SKU IDs in the term sheet.
- Entitlement flow: Redwood supports both flows. Recommended approach for reseller-led provisioning is: Nebula consumes the CPPO entitlement webhook -> your entitlement system calls our/entitlements API to assign access. We can also do entitlement pulls if you'd prefer vendor-initiated provisioning.
- Billing split: Redwood has standard templates that support both upfront split and invoice reconciliation. For pilots we recommend invoice reconciliation (monthly) with a 60/40 split configurable in the billing CSV. Need legal to sign off on language for revenue recognition.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II is available — attaching the evidence stub. For EU-origin customers in Private deployments we offer region pinning; hosted CPPO traffic will be routed to us-east-1 by default unless you request eu-west-1.

Next steps I propose below — copying internal ops to coordinate: Ben, Priyom, Vanessa.

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CPPO_term_sheet_v3.pdf (stub), SOC2_evidence_link.txt (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T09:45:00Z
Subject: Internal: Nebula CPPO sprint — who owns what

Team —

Marcus from Nebula asked for a one-page term + billing CSV by Tue EOD. Quick division of labor: 

- Ben: lead on billing_split_template.xlsx — can you draft a 60/40 invoice reconciliation example (monthly) and include fields for SKU id, unit price, usage_units, reseller_share, vendor_share? I attached our current template and the SKU guidance from the product team.
- Priyom: legal/term edits — please review CPPO_term_sheet_v3.pdf and flag any clauses on revenue recognition / taxes we should surface.
- Vanessa: ops handoff — coordinate the entitlement webhook behavior and provide the entitlement API contract; we need a one-page developer ETA for Nebula's engineers.

Timelines: Ben & Vanessa to have first drafts back by EOD Monday (2028-07-02) so I can package and send to Marcus Tuesday morning PST. Priyom, if you need extra time, call it out.

Notes: AWS PM Priya is looped; she wants to include the CPPO in the co-sell play once terms are signed.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachment referenced: billing_split_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: Nebula CPPO sprint — who owns what

All —

I pulled the billing template into a working copy and modeled two options: (A) monthly invoice reconciliation (recommended for pilot) and (B) upfront committed credits split (for committed bookings). For the pilot, I mocked a 60/40 split with the following assumptions: 1) reseller receives their share on the month-end settlement CSV, 2) Redwood invoices AWS for total usage and passes reseller share via a separate settlement.

I've added a sample line for both SKUs (redwood.gptx-8q and redwood.gptx-8fp) and included a column for "reseller_entity_id" that maps to Nebula's billing ID.

I also added a short paragraph we can include in the term sheet clarifying settlement timing (net 30) and currency. If everyone is good, I'll convert the sample to CSV and attach a DocuSign powerform for Marcus to sign.

DocuSign draft link (powerform): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-12345

Ben
Sr. Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@nebularesell.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@amazon.com>, Kate Oliver <kate.oliver@nebularesell.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T14:02:00Z
Subject: Nebula CPPO — consolidated plan, term sheet & next steps

Hi Marcus / Kate / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per our internal sprint sync, attached is the one-page CPPO term (CPPO_term_sheet_v3.pdf) and the billing template (billing_split_template.xlsx) pre-filled with the 60/40 pilot example. Summary below: 

Summary: 
- SKUs: redwood.gptx-8q (quantized) and redwood.gptx-8fp (fallback). Both will be listed in the CPPO catalog.
- Entitlement: Nebula will consume our entitlement webhook and call Redwood's entitlement API to provision — Vanessa will send the API contract separately.
- Billing: pilot will run on monthly invoice reconciliation; sample CSV populated and includes reseller_entity_id for Nebula. We modeled a 60% reseller / 40% Redwood split; DocuSign link for the term is below.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence attached; region pinning options noted (default us-east-1).

Action items: 
1) Marcus — please review attached term + billing CSV and return signed DocuSign (powerform) by 2028-07-03 if comfortable. Link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-12345
2) Kate — share Nebula's reseller_entity_id to populate the final CSV.
3) Priya (AWS) — can you confirm co-sell activation rules once the DocuSign is complete?
4) Vanessa — send entitlement API contract and sample webhook payload to Marcus' eng team (copy me).
5) Priyom — finalize legal redlines; I'm happy to take follow-ups with Nebula counsel.

If there are any major objections on the split, flag them now — otherwise we'll proceed to DocuSign and ops handoff.

Best,
Soojin
Director, Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CPPO_term_sheet_v3.pdf, billing_split_template.xlsx
